name: VolunTeens at Wellstar North Fulton Hospital
org: Wellstar Health System, North Fulton Hospital (Roswell)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital over the summer. You work one two-hour shift each week for six of the eight summer weeks.
who_can_apply: High school students aged 16 to 18. You need shot records, a school counselor form and an interview.
duration: Summer session in June and July: one two-hour shift per week for six of the eight weeks
deadline_text: Applications open each February, interviews in March, orientation in April. The page does not give a 2027 closing date.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online VolunTeen application. Email your shot record (2 MMR, 2 chickenpox or proof you had it, 1 Tdap) as a PDF. Have your school counselor sign the recommendation form and email it. Then you are called for an interview.
notes: Spots are limited. Not everyone is accepted. Picks look at past service, GPA, leadership and interest in health careers. Students accepted for summer may keep volunteering in the school year with approval.
